research_scope: Independent Wave2 source-free contextual mathematical prerequisite audit; only reviewed shared constructions, retaining source-specific quantifiers, ambient types, and hypotheses; no source edits, certification, breadth or gate promotion.

aliases.reason: The geometric-irreducibility source uses A⊗_k K for a commutative unital k-algebra A and field extension K/k. Five geometrically reduced/connected/regular source contexts use R⊗_k K with precisely the same K-algebra multiplication (a⊗x)(b⊗y)=ab⊗xy. A versus R is a bound-variable name, not a new construction; geometric predicates and quantifiers over K stay parent-specific.

Splitting-field source requires a polynomial P to factor completely into linear factors over E. Normal algebraic extension sources require a polynomial to split over K as c∏(T−α_j), retaining leading scalar and multiplicities. These are the identical complete-linear-factorization prerequisite. Generation by roots, normality, and irreducibility are distinct parent-only assertions.

The preordered-set formulation demands a reflexive binary relation iRi for every i in I; the independent relation-property formulation uses (x,x)∈R for every x∈S. These are exactly the same quantified reflexivity property of a binary relation. Transitivity, symmetry, antisymmetry, and whether the relation is itself a preorder remain parent-specific.

The connected-component source selects a connected subset C inclusion-maximal among connected subsets of X. That is the ordinary poset definition of maximal element of a specified family of subsets under inclusion: no distinct admissible member properly contains C. The condition that the family consists of connected subsets remains essential and is not promoted to arbitrary maximality; maximal is not greatest or path-connected.

The étale-ring-map source uses H_1(C•)=ker(d_1)/im(d_2) for a naive cotangent chain complex, exactly the i=1 specialization of H_i(C•)=ker(d_i)/im(d_{i+1}) recorded in the Tor-from-free-resolution source. In the two-term complex d_2 has zero source; H_1=0 is an additional vanishing predicate, not part of the general definition of homology.
